items.headline: India's Retail Inflation Rises to 5.54% in September, Above RBI Target
items.summary: India's retail inflation accelerated to 5.54% in September 2026, driven by higher food prices, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% target. This keeps the focus on the central bank's policy-rate decisions, which had previously raised the repo rate.

items.headline: Rupee Strengthens Against US Dollar Amid RBI Intervention
items.summary: The Indian rupee gained significantly against the US dollar, rising by 62-96 paise to 95.16-95.80. This appreciation followed the Reserve Bank of India's measures aimed at curbing dollar demand in the spot and derivatives markets.

items.headline: Asian Markets Plunge on Chip Sell-Off and Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Asian markets, including South Korea's Kospi and Japan's Nikkei 225, saw sharp declines. The sell-off was primarily attributed to weakness in chip shares and escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, which also drove crude oil prices higher.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Remain Elevated Above $105 per Barrel
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices continued to trade above $105-$106 per barrel. The sustained high prices are a direct consequence of renewed geopolitical risks in the Middle East and concerns over the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: HCL Technologies Q2 FY27 Profit Jumps 21.18% on AI Operations and Lower Tax
items.summary: HCL Technologies reported a consolidated profit after tax of ₹5,132 crore for Q2 FY27, a 21.18% year-on-year increase. The growth was attributed to higher margins from its advanced AI operations and a reduced tax outgo. Revenue also increased by 11.5% to ₹35,620 crore.

items.headline: RBL Bank's Net Profit Soars to ₹481.7 Crore in Q2 FY27, Asset Quality Improves
items.summary: RBL Bank witnessed a significant surge in net profit to ₹481.7 crore in Q2 FY27, up from ₹179 crore a year earlier. Net interest income grew by 37.4%, and the bank's asset quality improved with declining gross and net NPAs.

items.headline: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Reports 6.1% Rise in Q2 FY27 Profit
items.summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company announced a 6.1% year-on-year increase in its Q2 FY27 profit after tax, reaching ₹889 crore. The company's revenue from operations also saw a healthy rise of 16.3% during the quarter.

items.headline: IT Sector Rallies Over 4% Led by HCLTech, TCS, and Infosys
items.summary: The Nifty IT index experienced a strong rally, gaining over 4% in early trade. This surge was primarily driven by better-than-expected Q2 results from HCLTech and TCS, alongside a slowdown in AI trade and the strengthening of the US dollar.

items.headline: Sugar and Paper Stocks Witness Fresh Buying Interest
items.summary: Sugar and paper stocks observed fresh buying momentum on October 12. This interest was sparked by rising global prices for both sugar and related products, indicating a positive outlook for these commodity-linked sectors.

items.headline: TD Power Systems Approves ₹600 Crore QIP Allotment
items.summary: TD Power Systems' fund-raising committee has approved the allotment of 7,741,935 equity shares to qualified institutional buyers at ₹775 per share, totaling approximately ₹600 crore, through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP).

items.headline: IRCON International Secures ₹862.46 Crore EPC Contract from East Central Railway
items.summary: IRCON International has been awarded an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contract valued at ₹862.46 crore by East Central Railway. This significant order win is expected to boost the company's order book.

items.headline: Polycab India Removed from NSE Equity Derivatives Segment Under IBC Framework
items.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) has decided to remove Polycab India from its equity derivatives segment. This action follows the company's shares being shortlisted under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) framework, mandating a 100% margin requirement on existing and new derivatives positions.

items.headline: Hindustan Composites Declares Special Interim Dividend of ₹21 Per Share
items.summary: Hindustan Composites has announced a special interim dividend of ₹21 per equity share for the financial year 2027. This move is likely to be positive for shareholders.

items.headline: Maruti Suzuki India's NCLAT Matter Rescheduled
items.summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) matter involving Maruti Suzuki India has been rescheduled. Investors will be watching for updates regarding this legal development.

content.outlook: Indian markets closed with robust gains, led by a significant rally in the IT sector. Strong market breadth, with advancing stocks considerably outnumbering declining ones, indicates broad participation. Domestic institutional buying provided crucial support, countering foreign outflows.
keyTakeaways: NIFTY 50 and SENSEX surged by over 1.4% each.
NIFTY IT was the top performer, rallying by +5.02%, with major IT stocks among top gainers.
Market breadth was overwhelmingly positive at 51 advances to 7 declines.
DIIs were net buyers with 3045.02cr, offsetting FII selling of 1708.48cr.
NIFTY Realty also performed well, gaining over 2%.
